entries.notes: Calibration repair preserved numerical output and added real event-loop yields. On 2026-10-13 main@5f7f398 runtime evidence covered >=5 expected maintenance cycles with no 200+ s event gap; CalibrationValidationWorker cycles remained CPU-heavy but yielded (longest event-stream gap 11 s in the audited window).
entries.rootCause: CalibrationValidationWorker repeatedly reloaded large agent/Kronos histories synchronously per confidence bucket; this was one independently reproduced event-loop blocking defect, but not the later 200-325 s residual freeze.
entries.title: Event-loop stall: ~3-minute freeze on prod PID 7244

entries.notes: Fix + regression test live on the sibling branch; verify both at merge (warn only, no hard block).

entries.notes: Verified 2026-10-12: test path exists in the tree on this branch and covers the generation-token isLiveCheck emission fence (8 references). Commit: 'ConfluenceCoordinator: fence superseded on-demand Quant evaluations (generation-token isLiveCheck) and log replacements'.

entries.title: ConfluenceCoordinator 10-min guard replaced still-running evaluations

entries.notes: Containment remains in place (8 s Quant caller bound; inner fetch timeout/coalescing controls). Root cause is NOT closed: Oct-13 runtime showed ~97% 1Min deadline outcomes. Repair PR #2 adds per-evaluation 1Min availability outcomes (AVAILABLE/EMPTY/DEADLINE/FETCH_ERROR/WINDOW_UNAVAILABLE) and IBKR historical queueWaitMs/serviceMs/totalMs telemetry so queue backlog can be separated from provider service latency. This is diagnostic evidence, not a timeout reduction or provider-policy change.
entries.rootCause: Intraday fetch timeout rate remained high (76.5%->54.6%). b842ef5 bounds the wait with a real timeout, but the data still doesn't arrive - mitigation, not a fix.
entries.title: Intraday provider backlog: 76.5%->54.6% fetch timeout rate

entries.notes: Sealed protective SELL bypasses ONLY daily_loss/consecutive_loss/portfolio_drawdown/order_rate_limit (plus news_veto earlier); mandatory position/order/session gates remain. Runtime 2026-10-13: S protective SELL passed RiskEngine and OMS and filled at IBKR PAPER at 09:19 ET after the spread gate cleared. Broker-resident stops remain absent.
entries.rootCause: Entry-oriented brakes had no side/intent branch, so the position-reducing exit that would stop a loss was rejected once those brakes tripped.

entries.notes: researchEquityRiskBasisEnabled (default true) switches daily_loss/portfolio_drawdown to research P&L on settings.budget. Limits: carried unrealized counted in full; unrealized peak in-process only.
entries.rootCause: daily_loss and portfolio_drawdown used ~$1M simulated broker equity, so a $20k budget with a $250 limit was not enforced on the research portfolio.

entries.notes: Exact adapter path for DDOG not proven (hypothesis: no zero-quantity position event on full exit). S 38 broker=0 vs ledger=38 is a separate, unresolved ledger/broker discrepancy.
entries.rootCause: positionEnd handler was empty; positions absent from a completed snapshot were never removed, causing a false POSITION_FILL_CONFLICT that paused trading (and Autobot) after a normal full exit.

entries.notes: CPU profile attributed 308 s self time to one better-sqlite3 .all(); slow-SQL named the pending-count statement. Read-only live DB comparison: old query ~231,858 ms, cast form ~142 ms. 2026-10-13 runtime main@5f7f398 observed >=5 would-be freeze cycles with no 200-325 s recurrence; longest event gap 11 s. This closes the catastrophic recurring-freeze class, not all slow SQL or maintenance CPU.
entries.rootCause: PredictionOutcomeEvaluator's Kronos pending-count LEFT JOIN compared prediction_outcomes.prediction_id TEXT to kronos_predictions.id INTEGER, defeating the unique index and causing one synchronous better-sqlite3 count to take ~231.9 s on the production DB. cast(kronos_predictions.id as text) restores the indexed lookup.

entries.notes: 20 of 21 strategies have no learning_versions record and resolve to terminal NOT_AUTHORIZED/NO_LIFECYCLE_RECORD; PULLBACK_CONTINUATION is RETIRED. Recording an UNTESTED baseline via recordStrategyLifecycleTransition is the system's own recommended action but changes routing; left for an explicit operator decision.
entries.rootCause: No production lifecycle baseline seeding; certification bridge requires operator review.

entries.notes: Observed S protective close: first risk-exit at ~09:14 ET rejected by extended_hours_execution_policy; generic 300 s exitIdeaCooldown suppressed retries until ~09:19 ET. Repair binds ownership to the exact protective trace; approved/PENDING/PARTIALLY_FILLED closes remain single-flight. Exact ownership is released on pre-Chief TRADE_IDEA_REJECTED / IDEA_RATE_LIMITED, Risk rejection, risk-assessment persistence failure, or terminal broker FILLED/REJECTED/CANCELED. Unrelated SELL traces cannot unlock it. No RiskEngine bypass or threshold change. Branch-only until exact-SHA CI and controlled runtime verification pass.
entries.rootCause: canEmitPortfolioExitIdea committed a symbol timestamp before Risk/OMS outcome and had no outcome-aware release path, so a failed protective close was throttled for the full generic five-minute idea cooldown.
entries.title: Protective exit retry suppressed for five minutes after Risk rejection

entries.notes: Escaped certification because synthetic sessions disabled MacroAgent and ran no Kronos (idea volume far below the cap) and the exit oracle default grace is 15 minutes, so a dropped-then-retried exit still passed. Fix: dual-key exemption (risk-exit agent + SELL + origin PORTFOLIO_EXIT), per-agent drop attribution. Test C replay saturates the real EventBus at production-equivalent rates and asserts same-tick delivery; verified to fail on 32613911 and pass on the fix.
entries.rootCause: EventBus.emit applied a first-come 120 ideas/min window to every TRADE_IDEA_GENERATED including genuine protective exits. Production research traffic (Kronos+Macro+Technical+Quant ~162/min) saturated it and dropped 28-33% of ideas. The 2026-10-13 repair accepted drops and released the exit cooldown for retry (~60 s) rather than exempting exits.
entries.title: Global idea cap applied to protective exits

entries.notes: CORRECTION 2026-10-15 14:05 ET: Jev API calls were live via AiAdvisoryService (160 completed calls that day). Only the shadow ledger (jev_shadow_scores) path was idle. Fix: ledger dedupe (duplicate article double-counted rows/tokens/cost), getJevShadowStatus() surfaced in the jev-calibration report, end-to-end test with a real HTTP boundary, JEV_SHADOW_PARITY certification check and classifyFeatureParity (configured != enabled != invoked != verified). A real authenticated isolated call succeeded on 2026-10-15. Production activation requires the flag plus a controlled restart.
entries.rootCause: ARGUS_JEV_SHADOW_SCORING_ENABLED defaults off and was never set; kickOffJevShadowScoring returns at its first line. The wiring (NewsEngine -> governor -> provider -> ledger) exists. Release certification reported JEV_CONFIGURED PASS from key presence and explicitly did not run wiring checks. The ledger test skipped DB round trips.
entries.title: Jev shadow-scoring LEDGER idle (configured, flag unset); the advisory Jev path was live

entries.notes: Measured effect: only NewsAgent has per-provider rows (12 of 41), News idea toggle is off, so no effect on 2026-10-15 confidences. Synthetic calibration seeding never wrote provider-specific rows, so the condition could not occur in any fixture.
entries.rootCause: calibrateConfidenceDetailed selected rows[0] with no provider filter; per-provider UUID rows sort before ALL in the unique index.
entries.title: ChiefTrader calibration lookup could return a per-provider row instead of the ALL row

entries.notes: Fix: bounded 2h default and 24h cap. The route was already covered by the router-level operatorReportGuard; a first attempt to add guardHeavyReport deadlocks against it (caught by operatorReportGuard.test.ts during certification) and was removed.
entries.rootCause: Route defaulted to a 24h (max 30d) window and ran synchronous observability_events queries on the engine event loop despite the router-level operatorReportGuard (which serializes but cannot make a sync query non-blocking) (7.5 s SLOW_SQL, 7.6 s loop lag at 09:37:55 ET). Attribution to the audit operator is inferred from timing.
entries.title: Default 24h trading-funnel report ran unguarded inside the trading process
